resolution: cran-comments.md was regenerated by tools/status/render-cran-comments.R from a fresh R CMD check log taken on an idle machine at commit 8e725b9, so every quantity in it is current: installed size 8.4Mb (doc 3.2, extdata 2.2) where it said 11.7Mb, 2 192 passing expectations across 92 test files where it said 2 051 across 88, and 5 unavailable Suggests named from the log. Its footer records the log's sha256 and the commit it was rendered at. tools/status/check-classification.json was stale in the same way and is corrected: it named a tarball at version 4.1.0 and '8 Suggests' while the package is 0.9.0 and the log names 5, and its own note explaining that counts are read from the log rather than stated had itself stated a count.

A .Rinstignore now excludes inst/rosc and inst/WORDLIST from the installed package, verified by installing to a temporary library and listing it -- the first pattern written, ^rosc$, matched nothing, because .Rinstignore matches paths relative to the source root rather than to inst/. inst/rosc/submission.md's quantitative self-report is generated from tools/status/facts.json by tools/status/render-submission-qa.R, including the version, which had declared 3.10.0 while the block below it conceded 0.9.0.

The false assertion no longer ships and no longer exists. inst/rosc/submission.md's checklist item now reads '0 errors, 0 warnings, 2 notes' and points at cran-comments.md for what each note is; the generated QA block states the check outcome rather than ticking a box that could only ever render as [x]. The file is also excluded from the installed package by .Rinstignore. RELEASE-CHECKLIST-v3.10.0.md, which asserted 'code 100 % ready, CI green', was deleted rather than merged.

The 1 345 figure is gone from its last surviving location. inst/rosc/submission.md's test and vignette counts are generated from a real run (2 192 expectations, 92 test files, 19 vignettes), and tests/testthat/test-submission-claims.R fails if the withdrawn figure is asserted again -- while allowing it to be disclosed, since the generated block names it to say it was false.

RELEASE-CHECKLIST-v3.10.0.md was deleted and RELEASE.md is the single checklist. The deleted file pointed at /tmp/edaphos_release_tarballs/edaphos_3.10.0.tar.gz, which does not exist, and named peaceiris/actions-gh-pages where .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml:61 uses JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4.5.0. RELEASE.md carries no version in its title, since both predecessors did and both went stale when the version moved, and its claim that everything besides the four manual steps 'is already in place' is replaced by a pointer to STATUS.md.

Same fix as F29E750: the two competing checklists are now one. RELEASE.md no longer claims a version and states that the four manual steps are the third-party half of a release, not the whole of the remaining work.

The pkgdown site builds. spatial_block_folds was exported without being in the reference index, which aborted the reference build outright; five vignettes (edaphos-paper, pilar7-bayesian-hierarchical, pilar8-neural-operators, pilar9-diffusion-models, pilar10-graph-attention) were missing from the articles index; and four navbar entries pointed at a top-level articles/ directory that pkgdown does not render, so they were 404s. All are fixed and both data_reference_index() and data_articles_index() now build against pkgdown 2.2.0.
